clips.title: The story
paras: On a rugged bluff above Pyrewood Village, Shadowfang Keep broods over southern Silverpine Forest. Once Silverlaine Keep, it fell to worgen summoned during the Third War and became the lair of the mad Archmage Arugal, haunted by slain nobles and overrun by wolf-beasts.

Before the Third War, Baron Silverlaine ruled nearby Pyrewood Village from his ancestral seat, Silverlaine Keep. When the Scourge swept through Lordaeron, desperate wizards sought forbidden means to stem the undead tide. Drawing on Dalaran mage Ur's dimensional research, Archmage Arugal summoned worgen from beyond this world. The savage beasts tore through the Scourge, then escaped control. They rampaged across southern Silverpine and besieged the keep, killing Baron Silverlaine, his family, and the defenders under Commander Springvale. Guilt and grief broke Arugal's sanity. He claimed the fortress, renamed it Shadowfang Keep, and called the monstrous predators his children.

Shadowfang Keep is the heart of a growing wolf curse in Silverpine Forest. Arugal dwells in the highest observatory, surrounded by ravenous worgen of the Moonrage and Shadowfang packs. Sinister beasts also prowl the keep, including his massive pet wolf, Fenrus. Below Arugal's sanctum, the restless ghosts of the keep's former lords and household remain trapped in torment. Baron Silverlaine and Commander Springvale are among them, cursed to defend the halls they failed to protect in life. From the walls, Arugal's influence reaches Pyrewood Village and the surrounding woodlands, threatening the neighboring Forsaken who seek to purge the forest of his madness.
